items.title: Geometric Star Hexagon DXF Mosaic for Precision-Cut Screens
items.description: Faceted stars and hexagons tessellate into a precise geometric mosaic that repeats mirrored across the panel. The crisp, mathematical pattern suits precision-cut screens, cabinet inserts, and modern architectural facades.
